id: \bI prepared for this.
en: \bI prepared for this.
it: \bMi sono preparato per questo.

id: Not enough.
en: Not enough.
it: Non basta.

id: \bPsychic types fear Bugs.
en: \bPsychic types fear Bugs.
it: \bI Pokémon Psico temono i Coleottero.

id: \bYou'll never beat Sabrina.
en: \bYou'll never beat Sabrina.
it: \bNon batterai mai Sabrina.

id: What?!
en: What?!
it: Cosa?!

id: \bSabrina wiped out the Karate Master next door.
en: \bSabrina wiped out the Karate Master next door.
it: \bSabrina ha spazzato via il Maestro di Karate qui accanto.

id: \rSabrina: Oh? You want to battle? Fine, but don't say I didn't warn you.
en: \rSabrina: Oh? You want to battle? Fine, but don't say I didn't warn you.
it: \rSabrina: Oh? Vuoi lottare? D'accordo, ma non dire che non ti avevo avvertito.

id: \rSabrina: You have potential but you are not good enough yet. Come back after you beat Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town. Then I'll battle seriously.
en: \rSabrina: You have potential but you are not good enough yet. Come back after you beat Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town. Then I'll battle seriously.
it: \rSabrina: Hai del potenziale, ma non sei ancora abbastanza bravo. Torna dopo aver superato la Torre Pokémon di Lavandonia. Allora lotterò sul serio.

id: \rWhat? You thought I was going to give you the badge? Haha, don't be silly.
en: \rWhat? You thought I was going to give you the badge? Haha, don't be silly.
it: \rCosa? Pensavi che ti avrei dato la medaglia? Haha, non essere sciocco.

id: \rSabrina: Come back when you beat Pokémon Tower.
en: \rSabrina: Come back when you beat Pokémon Tower.
it: \rSabrina: Torna quando avrai superato la Torre Pokémon.

id: \rSabrina: So, you came back. I thought you might. Well, let's see if you got any stronger, shall we?
en: \rSabrina: So, you came back. I thought you might.  Well, let's see if you got any stronger, shall we?
it: \rSabrina: Dunque sei tornato. Immaginavo che l'avresti fatto.  Bene, vediamo se sei diventato più forte, che ne dici?

id: \rSabrina: You've done very well. I admit that you're a talented and strong Trainer. Here, you earned the Marsh Badge.
en: \rSabrina: You've done very well. I admit that you're a talented and strong Trainer. Here, you earned the Marsh Badge.
it: \rSabrina: Sei stato davvero bravo. Ammetto che sei un Allenatore forte e di talento. Ecco, ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Palude.

id: \rHere, have this TM too.
en: \rHere, have this TM too.
it: \rEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \rTM04 contains Calm Mind. It raises the Special Attack and Special Defense of a Pokémon.
en: \rTM04 contains Calm Mind. It raises the Special Attack and Special Defense of a Pokémon.
it: \rLa MT04 contiene Calmamente. Aumenta l'Attacco Speciale e la Difesa Speciale di un Pokémon.

id: \rSabrina: I feel much better now. Thank you \PN.
en: \rSabrina: I feel much better now. Thank you \PN.
it: \rSabrina: Ora mi sento molto meglio. Grazie, \PN.

id: \rWho goes there?
en: \rWho goes there?
it: \rChi va là?

id: Waa.
en: Waa.
it: Waa.

id: \rI knew that this was going to take place.
en: \rI knew that this was going to take place.
it: \rSapevo che sarebbe successo.

id: \bSabrina uses Psychic type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Ghost, and Dark types.
en: \bSabrina uses Psychic type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Ghost, and Dark types.
it: \bSabrina usa Pokémon di tipo Psico. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Spettro e Buio.

id: \bThey are strong against Fighting and Poison. Psychic and Fighting moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Fighting and Poison.  Psychic and Fighting moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Lotta e Veleno.  Anche le mosse Psico e Lotta non fanno loro molto danno.

id: \rPrepare yourself.
en: \rPrepare yourself.
it: \rPreparati.

id: No!
en: No!
it: No!

id: \rI have much to learn still...
en: \rI have much to learn still...
it: \rHo ancora molto da imparare...

id: \rIn a battle of equals, the one with the stronger will win.
en: \rIn a battle of equals, the one with the stronger will win.
it: \rIn una lotta tra pari, vince chi ha la volontà più forte.

id: I see.
en: I see.
it: Capisco.

id: \rIf you wish to beat Sabrina, focus and will yourself to victory.
en: \rIf you wish to beat Sabrina, focus and will yourself to victory.
it: \rSe vuoi battere Sabrina, concentrati e conquista la vittoria con la forza di volontà.

id: \bBeat me first. Then we will see if you are good enough for Sabrina.
en: \bBeat me first. Then we will see if you are good enough for Sabrina.
it: \bPrima battimi. Poi vedremo se sei all'altezza di Sabrina.

id: Perhaps you are.
en: Perhaps you are.
it: Forse lo sei.

id: \bI can use telepathy to read your mind!
en: \bI can use telepathy to read your mind!
it: \bPosso usare la telepatia per leggerti nel pensiero!

id: \bYou dare challenge me?
en: \bYou dare challenge me?
it: \bOsi sfidarmi?

id: I didn't expect that.
en: I didn't expect that.
it: Questo non me l'aspettavo.

id: \bThere used to be two Pokémon Gyms in Saffron. We destroyed any chances of them staying though.
en: \bThere used to be two Pokémon Gyms in Saffron. We destroyed any chances of them staying though.
it: \bUna volta a Zafferanopoli c'erano due Palestre Pokémon. Però abbiamo distrutto ogni possibilità che restassero entrambe.

en: \bThere used to two Pokémon Gyms in Saffron. We destroyed any chances of them staying though.
